verdict.rationale: Sales Cloud pricing lists 'Access to AgentExchange', a first-party marketplace where users can find, evaluate, and plug in trusted third-party agents, sub-agents, and MCP servers within Agentforce Builder. That is a marketplace of installable third-party extensions, but it is agent-focused rather than a general integrations marketplace. Missing for 10: evidence of prebuilt Slack, support-desk, marketing, or data-warehouse integrations; a general app marketplace for Sales Cloud; an ops-user install flow; independent corroboration.
